description: Arithmetic examples for CPU-only simulator validation. ascend-generic is a placeholder, not a characterized Ascend product. No CANN, torch_npu, HCCL or NPU measurements are represented.
source: Hand-constructed deterministic arithmetic examples in this repository.

shape_semantics.batch_size: Number of tasks in one simulator iteration.
shape_semantics.batch_tokens: Sum of full prompt lengths plus one token per decode task.
shape_semantics.context_tokens: Sum of request.processed_tokens for decode tasks only; zero for pure prefill.

limitations: For plumbing and scheduling examples only; not evidence of real accelerator throughput or latency.
Sparse sample shapes require explicit nearest lookup for the example traces.
No pipeline parallelism, kernel, memory bandwidth or collective simulation.
